title: Tool set item
description: A row on the Tools page (`.tools-list-setrow`): a tool set with its enablement switch, name, one-line description, enabled/total count, optional \u22ef More actions and a chevron to expand its tools; or a connected source (`.tools-list-connected-row`) with Start and its switch.
usage: Rows of a kind="tools" <vsc-customization-list>. Live groups: Built-in Tools (Copilot \u2014 locked, VS Code, Integrated Browser, Automations, Compare implementation attempts, Sessions List), Connected Sources, Extension Tools.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Enabled/total, e.g. "17/17". Omit for connected sources.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.description: No switch (the Copilot set, which can't be turned off): the toggle keeps its space but is hidden.

attributes.name: more
attributes.description: Show the ⋯ More actions button (extension tool sets).

attributes.name: connected
attributes.description: Connected source row (MCP server running on the client): no chevron, optional Start button, read-only.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Shows its tools (following <vsc-tool-item> rows); the chevron toggles it and dispatches expand

examples.title: Tool sets
